Blau Batch Apple Icon (B Mark on Navy Square)
nodes.description: Square 1024x1024 iOS app icon. Stylized 'B' lettermark composed of layered blue segments (dark navy #1B2A4A, mid-blue #2D5FA6, sky blue #3E9BD4) forming a geometric B shape with a white negative-space left stem, set on a solid dark navy (#1B2A4A) background. Used as the Apple Touch / iOS home screen icon for the Blau Batch web app.
nodes.design_notes: Multi-tone blue segmentation on the B mark conveys layering/spectrum — reinforcing the 'Full-Spectrum Masterbatch Solutions' tagline. Square crop with no padding, optimized for iOS rounded-rect masking.
nodes.purpose: iOS/Safari browser icon — favicon tier for Apple devices

nodes.label: Blau Batch PWA / Browser Icon (B Mark on Navy Square)
nodes.description: Visually identical to apple-icon.png: square 1024x1024 icon featuring the multi-segment geometric B lettermark in blue tones on a navy background. Used as the Next.js app/ directory icon (PWA manifest / browser tab icon fallback).
nodes.design_notes: Same artwork as apple-icon; served as the generic web app icon for non-Apple contexts.
nodes.purpose: General web/PWA app icon

nodes.label: Blau Batch Favicon (SVG Vector B Mark)
nodes.description: SVG version of the Blau Batch B lettermark favicon. Vector-based, scalable to any size. Same visual design as the PNG icons — geometric multi-layer B in blue segments on navy background. Being SVG it retains crispness at all resolutions and supports theming via CSS.
nodes.design_notes: SVG favicon preferred in modern browsers for sharp rendering on HiDPI/Retina displays. File was too large to read directly (~207k tokens), indicating a complex path/shape SVG rather than a simplified icon.
nodes.purpose: Browser tab favicon — vector format for all modern browsers

nodes.label: Blau Batch Horizontal Logo — Light/White Variant
nodes.description: Full horizontal lockup of the Blau Batch brand. Left side: the B lettermark inside a dark navy square container, rendered in multi-tone blue segments with white negative space. Right side: wordmark 'BLAU BATCH' in bold extra-heavy sans-serif type (navy #1B2A4A), with tagline 'Full-Spectrum Masterbatch Solutions' in a lighter medium-weight blue below. White/transparent background — suitable for use on light surfaces.
nodes.design_notes: Horizontal layout optimized for header/navbar placement. Tagline establishes the brand's value proposition directly. The navy square around the mark acts as a consistent container across contexts.
nodes.typography: Extra-bold/Black weight sans-serif for wordmark; medium-weight sans-serif for tagline
nodes.purpose: Primary horizontal logo lockup for light backgrounds — headers, email, documents

nodes.label: Blau Batch Logo Mark — Navy Background Variant (PNG)
nodes.description: Standalone B lettermark on a solid dark navy (#1B2A4A) square background. The mark uses layered segments of navy, mid-blue, and sky blue with a white negative-space vertical stem forming the letter B. Identical visual to the app icons but used as a standalone public asset (not the app/ directory icon).
nodes.design_notes: Navy background variant intended for use on dark surfaces, reversed layouts, or as a standalone avatar/profile mark.
nodes.purpose: Standalone logomark for dark backgrounds — social avatars, dark headers, watermarks

nodes.label: Blau Batch Logo Mark — Navy Variant (SVG Vector)
nodes.description: SVG vector version of the navy-background B lettermark. Same design as logo-mark-navy.png but in scalable vector format. The very large file size (~207k tokens) indicates a highly detailed path-based SVG preserving all segment geometry and color precision.
nodes.design_notes: SVG preferred for print, high-resolution digital, and any context requiring infinite scalability without rasterization artifacts.
nodes.purpose: Scalable vector logomark — print, high-res digital, CSS/SVG embedding

nodes.label: Blau Batch Logo Mark — Transparent Background (PNG)
nodes.description: The Blau Batch B lettermark on a transparent/white background (no navy container square). The B shape is rendered in medium and sky blues (#3E9BD4 dominant, #2D5FA6 secondary) with white negative-space cutouts defining the letter form. Without the navy background the mark feels lighter and more open — the vertical left stem of the B is defined purely by white space against the blue forms.
nodes.design_notes: Transparent-background variant maximizes flexibility — can be composited onto any colored surface. The blue-only mark (no dark bg) reads differently: more airy, suitable for light or photographic backgrounds.
nodes.purpose: Flexible logomark for compositing on any background color or image

nodes.label: Blau Batch Wordmark Only — Navy Text on White
nodes.description: Text-only wordmark: 'BLAU BATCH' in extra-bold/black weight sans-serif typography, rendered in deep navy (#1B2A4A) on a white background. No mark/symbol present. The letterforms are wide, rounded at terminals, and very heavy — consistent with a geometric sans-serif typeface (likely a custom or premium display font).
nodes.design_notes: Text-only variant used when the mark is already present in context (e.g., a page where the icon appears separately) or when minimal/clean branding is needed. All-caps treatment conveys authority and industrial precision.
nodes.typography: Extra-bold/Black geometric sans-serif, all-caps, wide tracking
nodes.purpose: Text-only wordmark for contexts where the symbol is redundant or space is limited

nodes.label: Blau Batch Wordmark Only — White Text on Navy (Reversed)
nodes.description: Reversed/inverted wordmark: 'BLAU BATCH' in white extra-bold sans-serif on a solid dark navy (#1B2A4A) background. Same typeface and layout as logo-textonly-navy.png but color-inverted for use on dark surfaces.
nodes.design_notes: Reversed variant for dark headers, footers, dark-mode UI, or any navy/dark background context. Maintains legibility and brand consistency across both light and dark applications.
nodes.purpose: Reversed wordmark for dark backgrounds — footers, dark headers, print on dark stock

nodes.label: Blau Batch Logo Mark — JPEG Social/Profile Variant
nodes.description: The Blau Batch B lettermark on a dark navy background, saved as JPEG (lossy). The mark uses the same multi-layer blue segment design but appears slightly softer/larger crop with more visible navy padding around the B. The B itself shows the same color layers: navy dark, mid-blue, sky blue, white negative space. Slight JPEG compression artifacts visible at segment edges.
nodes.design_notes: JPEG format suggests this is intended for social media profiles, OG images, or platforms that don't support transparency. Lossy compression trades file size for compatibility. The slightly different crop/padding ratio compared to the PNG icons may be intentional for social platform square-crop requirements.
nodes.purpose: Social media profile image / Open Graph image / JPEG-required platform icon

nodes.label: Blau Batch Brand Identity System

nodes.description: Three-tier blue color system extracted from all brand assets: (1) Deep Navy #1B2A4A — primary brand dark, used for backgrounds, wordmark, and dark UI surfaces.
